# **Introduction:**
Hey everyone, I have been part of the community and contributing for almost a year and a half. I have contributed to Edgeware in many ways. I technically set up the rosetta API integration, the delegation UI, the documentation website, and SimpleUI, and I run an edgeware validator. Through education, this being youtube tutorial videos and leading a cohort on educating the technical abilities of Edgeware and updating documentation. I have recently created the simple UI and will soon deploy an escrow dapp on Edgeware’s EVM. My strengths are web development, smart contract development, and teaching others.
